original_question_en: List the most recently submitted TDocs targeting Rel-18 (contribution status by release).
original_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}) MATCH (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

original_Korean_row.question: Rel-18 타겟 Tdoc 중 최근 제출된 목록은? (Release별 기고 현황)
original_Korean_row.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}) MATCH (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

sort_rules.CQ1: Meeting 번호 DESC, Tdoc 번호 ASC
sort_rules.CQ3: Count DESC, Company 이름 ASC (집계); Tdoc 번호 ASC (목록)
sort_rules.CQ4: Meeting 번호 DESC, Tdoc 번호 ASC

direct_SQL_full_before_limit:
SELECT t.node_id,t.tdocNumber,t.title,t.type,t.status,t.uploadedDate,t.reservationDate,m.meetingNumber,m.meetingNumberInt FROM Tdoc t JOIN rel_TARGET_RELEASE tr ON tr.src_id=t.node_id
        JOIN Release r ON r.node_id=tr.dst_id JOIN rel_PRESENTED_AT pa ON pa.src_id=t.node_id
        JOIN Meeting m ON m.node_id=pa.dst_id WHERE r.releaseName='Rel-18' ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC,t.tdocNumber ASC
